findings_addressed.oracle: Populates _fiber_combo with TID=777 and _tls_thread_combo with TID=888, calls _on_tls, then asserts bridge.tls_calls[0] == 888 AND != 777. Under the F-0011 regression (_on_tls reads _fiber_combo), the bridge receives 777 not 888, causing both assertions to fail.

deletions.reason: FALSE-POSITIVE prod-defect gate. A prior fixer (scope creep beyond the wave's only finding G0020) added this test and declared a production defect PD-F0019 (that _on_write_registers ignores _reg_last_edited_col and always reads column 1/hex). This is NOT a real, user-observable defect: _on_reg_cell_changed syncs the companion column on every edit (verified: editing decimal writes the correct hex into column 1 via _sync_register_companion_cell), so reading column 1 always yields the value the user entered. The F-0019 bug ('decimal edits silently discarded') is genuinely fixed by the sync. This deleted test fabricated an UNREACHABLE state: _add_reg_row() calls blockSignals(True), bypassing the sync, then the test manually sets _reg_last_edited_col[1]=2 while leaving hex='0x0' and decimal='99999' in disagreement - a state no real UI interaction can produce (editing decimal would have synced hex). It therefore went RED against correct production code, gating a redundant implementation detail (which column write physically reads) rather than user-observable behavior. The real, reachable behavior is fully covered by the GREEN test_write_registers_reads_decimal_column, which drives the genuine cellChanged -> _on_reg_cell_changed sync (setItem WITHOUT blockSignals) and asserts the decimal value reaches the bridge; that test IS falsifiable against the original F-0019 bug (remove the sync -> decimal edit leaves hex stale -> write discards it -> assertion fails). Sandbox ground truth (2026-06-22): last_edited_col_governs FAILED, reads_decimal_column/reads_hex_column/decimal_edit_syncs_hex/all F-0011 PASSED. After deletion threads_tab is fully green.

notes: Wave finding G0020 (N8 existence/identity check) replaced with a behavioral gate that verifies exact TID routing to the bridge from _tls_thread_combo, falsifiable against the F-0011 regression. The fixer's added F-0019 tests are kept where they gate real reachable behavior (test_write_registers_reads_decimal_column, test_write_registers_reads_hex_column, test_decimal_edit_syncs_hex - all green and falsifiable against removal of the column sync). The one F-0019 test that asserted an unreachable hex/decimal-disagreement state was deleted as a false-positive defect gate (see deletions[]); the previously-recorded PD-F0019 is NOT a real production defect and has been removed. No src/ file was modified.
